_meta.purpose: Resolve raw ingredient tokens (from OCR) to canonical forms. Handles INS/E-number prefixes, common misspellings, and 'hidden sugar' aliases. In production the LLM layer does fuzzy normalization; this table handles the deterministic, high-frequency cases.
_meta.how_to_use: 1) strip INS/E prefixes to bare numbers. 2) lowercase, trim. 3) apply synonym map. 4) apply sugar-alias grouping.

additive_class_words._note: A bracket after one of these words holds additive numbers, so bare numbers inside it are read as INS numbers. Without a class word a number stays a quantity ('250 g' is not sodium nitrite). Add words as real labels show them.

sugar_aliases._note: All of these are 'added sugar' for the sugar-count heuristic. Marketing hides sugar behind many names; counting them together is a key user-trust feature. D-120: candy sugar syrup and sugar syrup added (FSSAI L&D 2020, added sugars = mono- and disaccharides added); bare malt deliberately not (malted grain). D-132: khandsari, bura and misri added: FSSAI FPS&FA 2011 2.8.1(3), 2.8.1(4) and 2.8.2 (compendium XXVI, PDF pp. 341 to 342, read 2026-09-29) define them as sugar with at least 93%, 90% and 98% sucrose, a disaccharide, so added sugar under L&D 2020 5(3)(a)(ii). Coconut sugar not added: no FSSAI standard defines it.
